name: ABBA
Description: ABBA were a Swedish pop group formed in Stockholm in 1972 by Agnetha Fältskog, Björn Ulvaeus, Benny Andersson, and Anni-Frid Lyngstad. They are one of the most popular and successful musical groups of all time

name: Michael Jackson
Description: Michael Joseph Jackson was an American singer, songwriter, dancer, and philanthropist. Dubbed the King of Pop, he is regarded as one of the most significant figures of the 20th century

name: Kenny Rogers
Description: Kenneth Ray Rogers was an American singer and songwriter. He was inducted into the Country Music Hall of Fame in 2013

name: Rihanna
Description: Robyn Rihanna Fenty is a Barbadian singer, businesswoman and actress

name: Bad Bunny
Description: Benito Antonio Martínez Ocasio, best known by his stage name Bad Bunny, is a Puerto Rican rapper, singer, and record producer
